notes: THE EMPEROR. A hype anime-edit music video for a Michael Kaiser (Blue Lock) character song: an original stylised version of the emperor striker (blond hair blue underneath, blue eyes, a smirk, a blue rose tattoo on the neck) in his black-and-red kit, his burgundy suit, and a red ermine-trimmed royal cape. Motifs: blue roses, the crown, chains, the ball, floodlit night stadiums, manga speed lines. Arc: a blue rose blooms in the dark and turns out to be the tattoo on his neck; a crown of light assembles as he claims the throne; he cuts through defenders under floodlights; the first KAISER IMPACT volley freezes time and blows the net into rose petals; he lounges on his throne among bouquets; a neon-blue night city; manga panels slam in on the beat; a rival's silhouette shatters inside his head; the second KAISER IMPACT is fired from the sky above a stadium and a giant crown descends; the outro is his quiet reign on the throne as the music fades. Every drum hit should move something.

A1 intro, frames 0-743 (bass and pad from the start, humming vocal 2.9-10 s, a short drum burst at P.revealT = 11.47 s (frame 344) to 13.3 s, the rap starting at P.rapT = 12.85 s). THE EMPEROR RISES. 0-10 s: deep navy darkness with drifting fog (worldkit.field, very dark, low contrast) and a few slow blue petals; hanging chains fade in and out of the dark at the edges (drawChain). At the centre a single BLUE ROSE (drawRose, large, r ~170) blooms: each humming note (F.ev.voc_notes onsets) opens it a step further and sends a soft ring of blue light outward; thorny vines (curved strokes with small thorn triangles) grow from it across the frame on each note. P.revealT (frame 344): the drum burst rattles the chains (they swing) and a white light flash. From P.rapT (frame 386) the camera PULLS BACK from the rose: it is the tattoo on the neck of Kaiser (KAISER_SUIT), seen in an extreme close-up portrait (use puppet.solve to place the head large: head radius ~250 px at first, shrinking as the camera pulls back), side-lit in blue, eyes closed... at P.visionT (frame 452) his eyes open: a cold blue glint (sparkle) in each eye. 17-22 s: keep pulling back to a waist-up and then full-figure shot of him standing in a dark hall, smirking, the rose on his neck glowing; behind him a giant CROWN made of gold light lines assembles: one segment on P.futureT (frame 600), more on P.rulerT (frame 648), and on P.kingT (frame 696) it completes with a gold burst and light rays, and the chains around the hall snap (drawChain broken 0->1). The last frames (696-743) push in on him with speed lines (speedLines, white, alpha 0.4) building to the engine's white flash at 24.81 s (frame 744). The engine draws the title card at the bottom centre from 1.5 to 9 s: keep that area dark and calm then. KEY FRAMES: 0, 90, 150, 240, 300, 344, 360, 386, 420, 452, 520, 600, 648, 696, 720, 743. Must NOT: no text, letters, numbers, logos or lyrics anywhere (only the engine's title card draws text); no copying of official anime art: use scenes/lib/kaiser.mjs (KAISER kit, KAISER_SUIT, drawCape, drawRose, drawCrown, drawChain, drawBall, speedLines, streakLines) and the puppet rig; no raw full-screen fractal noise or rainbow cycling; no Math.random/Date/performance or state between frames; no hard-coded song times in code (use P and F.ev).

B1, frames 744-1202 (the beat is in from 25.29 s: about 150 BPM, kicks and snares all the way). THE FIELD: a NIGHT STADIUM. Build a shared stadium drawing in scenes/lib/kzstadium.mjs (you own it; kzImpact uses it too): tiered stands full of crowd (stamped silhouettes, crowd colour, phone-flash sparkles), four floodlight towers with big glowing lamps and light cones, the pitch in perspective (stripes, white lines, penalty box), a goal with a net. Kaiser (KAISER, the kit) dribbles the ball (drawBall, rolling at his feet) toward the camera in a low tracking shot (he stays centred and large, about 420 px tall; the pitch and stands scroll past). Rival defenders (rivalDesign in rival colours) rush in from the sides one or two per bar; on a beat he skips past each with a sharp sidestep: an echo trail of after-images (fx.echo of his figure in blue, alpha decaying), a burst of speed lines, and the defender spins away and falls. Floodlights flare on every kick, crowd flashes sparkle on hats, white streak lines (streakLines) rush past on snares. Cut the framing every 4 bars on a downbeat between: the low tracking shot, a side-on run (side view, full stride, running cycle locked to the beat), and a high wide shot of the whole stadium with him tiny and the defenders scattering. At P.kaiserT (frame 1125) he stops dead with his foot on the ball and spreads his arms (poses.armsUp variant), the crowd goes wild; at P.emperorT (frame 1178) a gold crown (drawCrown) flashes above his head with light rays until the end of the entry. KEY FRAMES: 744, 760, 800, 860, 920, 1000, 1060, 1125, 1150, 1178, 1202. Cut the framing every 4 bars on a downbeat: a wide symmetric shot of the hall, a medium shot of him lounging, a close-up of his face and hand (head large), a low angle from the floor past the ball, a slow dolly along the rose bouquets. transitions.why: the crown completes on his name: into the stadium
the drums drop out: time freezes
the volley hits the net as the drums slam back
his name: into the throne room
the cover freeze opens into manga panels
the second impact explodes over the stadium
the bass leaves: fade with the last note
